{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:11:11.447520Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:11:11.447305Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:11:12.567898Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:11:12.566398Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:11:12.570804Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:11:12.569849Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.492911Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.491454Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.495492Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.495105Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.513119Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.512481Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.518535Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.518288Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.548878Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.548354Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.983\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.982\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     892.4\n",
      "Date:                Sat, 21 Nov 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           9.39e-41\n",
      "Time:                        14:11:15   Log-Likelihood:                0.25768\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                             7.485\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                             15.13\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          4.9632      0.086     58.020      0.000       4.791       5.135\n",
      "x1             0.5109      0.013     38.725      0.000       0.484       0.537\n",
      "x2             0.5070      0.052      9.777      0.000       0.403       0.611\n",
      "x3            -0.0215      0.001    -18.559      0.000      -0.024      -0.019\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        0.797   Durbin-Watson:                   1.979\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.671   Jarque-Bera (JB):                0.783\n",
      "Skew:                          -0.032   Prob(JB):                        0.676\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       2.390   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.552278Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.552074Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.559171Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.558699Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.42578755  4.91973937  5.3734621   5.75932209  6.05965856  6.26968515\n",
      "  6.39827635  6.46650944  6.50420153  6.54501073  6.62090618  6.75691564\n",
      "  6.96701348  7.25182473  7.59852242  7.98293498  8.37351757  8.73653482\n",
      "  9.04160344  9.26668412  9.40170251  9.45020444  9.42877331  9.36430552\n",
      "  9.28959143  9.23792804  9.23764834  9.30746634  9.45340234  9.66779387\n",
      "  9.93055457 10.21247437 10.48001857 10.70083753 10.8490816  10.90964819\n",
      " 10.88066302 10.77378811 10.6123057  10.4272931  10.25251672 10.11888438\n",
      " 10.04936721 10.0552256  10.13415913 10.27068449 10.43867942 10.60567445\n",
      " 10.73818756 10.80722523]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.565149Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.564950Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.571179Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.570700Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[10.77737544 10.61302773 10.33406657  9.98580618  9.62789601  9.31971647\n",
      "  9.10584055  9.00512081  9.00607355  9.06969052]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.576029Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.575715Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.973104Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.972374Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x7b490e2cf380>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.975549Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.975333Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.991695Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.990503Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.994412Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:11:15.993570Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:11:16.011494Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:11:16.010771Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           4.963218\n",
       "x1                  0.510899\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.507047\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.021497\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:11:16.013988Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:11:16.013769Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:11:16.032186Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:11:16.031702Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    10.777375\n",
       "1    10.613028\n",
       "2    10.334067\n",
       "3     9.985806\n",
       "4     9.627896\n",
       "5     9.319716\n",
       "6     9.105841\n",
       "7     9.005121\n",
       "8     9.006074\n",
       "9     9.069691\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
